sentences.text: The Respondent No.2 before us lodged a First Information Report with the Women Police Station, Jaipur City (South) dated 15-7-2021 18:57:18 IST
Reason: being F.I.R. No.0090/2021 for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 406 & 323 respectively of the Indian Penal Code.

4. We take notice of the fact that the Petitioner No.1 before us is the father-in-law, the Petitioner No.2 is the mother-in-law, the Petitioner No.3 is the sister-in-law and the Petitioner No.4 is the brother-in-law of the Respondent No.2  First Informant.
5. The filing of the charge-sheet culminated in Criminal Case No.108/2022 pending as on date in the Court of the Judicial Magistrate, Jaipur.
6. However, we also take notice of the fact that the petitioners before us have preferred Criminal Miscellaneous Petitions for quashing of the criminal proceedings.

7. Mr. Rajiv Shakdher, the learned Senior counsel appearing for the petitioners would submit that on one hand, the quashing petitions are being heard by the High Court and on the other, the Trial Court wants to proceed further with the matter.
If the trial commences, the proceedings before the High Court would become infructuous and the same cause serious prejudice to his clients.

8. In the peculiar facts and circumstances of this, we request the High Court to take up Criminal Miscellaneous (Petition) No. 7218/2022, Criminal Miscellaneous (Petition) No. 7586/2022,
Criminal Miscellaneous (Petition) No. 7766/2022 & Criminal Miscellaneous (Petition) No.
8377/2022 for hearing at the earliest and see to it that all these petitions are disposed of within a period of two months from today.
9. With the aforesaid, the Special Leave Petition stands disposed of.
10. Pending applications, if any, also stand disposed of.
(VISHAL ANAND) (POOJA SHARMA)

ASTT. REGISTRAR-cum-PS COURT MASTER (NSH)
